notes: 15 TG / 81 TSG built for validation of GST documents (from GST_Taxonomy_TG_TSG_Final.xlsx). TG01-TG13 validation groups, TG14-TG15 support groups. Groups and sub-groups with created_by GKP were added by GKP when no existing sub-group fitted.

groups.name: Supply & Taxability
groups.description: Is it a taxable supply at all?

subgroups.name: Supply with consideration
subgroups.definition: Sale, transfer, barter, exchange, licence, rental, lease, disposal; import of services for consideration; business test for these
exclude: how to value non-money consideration → TSG04_04
subgroups.also_typically: CGST s.2(31) consideration, s.2(52) goods, s.2(102) services, s.2(105) supplier, s.2(93) recipient

subgroups.name: Supply without consideration (Schedule I)
subgroups.definition: Permanent transfer of business assets with ITC, supplies between distinct / related persons, principal–agent, import of services from related persons
include: Permanent transfer of business assets with ITC
import of services from related persons
subgroups.also_typically: CGST s.25(4) distinct persons; s.15 Explanation related persons

subgroups.name: Neither supply (Schedule III)
subgroups.definition: Schedule III activities; activities of Government notified under s.7(2)(b)
include: activities of Government notified under s.7(2)(b)
subgroups.also_typically: Notifications under s.7(2)(b); circulars on Schedule III

subgroups.name: Composite & mixed supply
subgroups.definition: Bundles: principal supply, composite vs mixed, which rate applies
exclude: Rate of the principal supply itself → TSG02_02

subgroups.name: Exempt, nil-rated & non-GST
subgroups.definition: Exempt supply, nil rate, non-taxable supply, alcohol / petroleum outside levy
exclude: Conditions of a specific exemption notification → TSG02_03

subgroups.name: Business test
subgroups.definition: Course or furtherance of business; what counts as business
